LayerMix.title: The Hallucination Signal Is a Mean Shift: Why Simple Probes Suffice
LayerMix.summary: In the paired-example paradigm, the hidden-state signal that separates factual from hallucinated responses is dominated by one direction. Removing it drops detection to chance.

ThinkFuse.title: ThinkFuse: Trajectory-Aware Test-Time Fusion for Small Reasoning Models
ThinkFuse.summary: A training-free test-time fusion framework that intervenes only in reasoning segments whose uncertainty stands out against the primary model's own trajectory.

skin-deep.title: Skin-Deep: A Geometric Diagnostic for Alignment Fragility in Large Language Model Representations
skin-deep.summary: Skin-Deep compares the residual-stream activations of an unmodified aligned checkpoint with its version-matched base checkpoint and summarizes the geometry in one score, computed without adversarial optimization or downstream fine-tuning, as a complement to refusal tests.

DART.title: DART: Draft-Agreement Routing for Training-Free Adaptive Thinking Budgets in Hybrid Reasoning Models
DART.summary: A training-free router for hybrid reasoning models: cheap no-think drafts decide when to think, and how much.

ACOER.title: Beyond Penalizing Mistakes: Stabilizing Efficiency Training in Large Reasoning Models via Adaptive Correct-Only Rewards
ACOER.summary: A correct-only length reward with an adaptive budget and weight that trains stably where length-reward baselines collapse, cutting the tokens generated on MATH-500 by more than half at accuracy on par with the base model.

MADARA.title: To Isolate or to Score? Model-Adaptive Assessment for Cost-Efficient Multi-Agent RAG
MADARA.summary: A training-free pipeline that diagnoses each model–task pair with a one-time probe and routes weak baselines to per-document isolation and strong baselines to a scoring treatment.

answer-leakage.title: Answer-Conditioned Chains of Thought Degrade Verifiable-Reasoning Distillation in Large Language Models
answer-leakage.summary: Chains of thought written to reach a shown gold answer pass the correctness filter, yet fine-tuning a strong reasoning model on them sharply lowers its verifiable-reasoning accuracy.

GLANCE.title: Vision Is Not Overhead: One-Pass Block Drafting for Lossless Speculative Decoding in Vision-Language Models
GLANCE.summary: GLANCE drafts a whole block in one forward pass over the target's already fused vision-language states, and the target commits exactly its greedy output.

Redline.title: Faster Block-Diffusion Serving with Distribution-Free Risk Guarantees
Redline.summary: Redline deploys the fastest serving configuration whose reference-relative risk it can keep within a user-chosen budget at a user-chosen confidence.

ByteCross.title: Where Activation Sparsity and KV-Cache Sparsity Cross in LLM Decoding
ByteCross.summary: A byte account of the decode step gives the context length at which the savings of activation sparsity and KV-cache sparsity are equal, from model dimensions and keep ratios alone.

PriceCheck.title: Risk-Controlled Selective LLM Answering by Pricing Label-Free Checks
PriceCheck.summary: PriceCheck prices label-free checks by their agreement rates and cost, composes the prices into schedules, and selects one schedule with a calibration test at a stated selective-risk target.

ALR-IRA.title: Recovering Off-Policy Supervision for Speculative Decoding
ALR-IRA.summary: Without modifying the training corpus, ALR relabels every slot of a draft block from greedy target rollouts and IRA places blocks inside those rollouts, recovering the supervision that erasing off-policy slots discards.

refusal-relocates.title: Refusal Localizes, the Damage Relocates: Safety Layers Under Few-Sample Fine-Tuning
refusal-relocates.summary: Clean-state patching restores refusal at a reproducible depth, but freezing every layer up to that depth leaves refusal near zero at a hundred harmful examples on all six checkpoints, with recovery transitions above the frozen boundary.

CAST.title: CAST: Cost-Aware Speculative Trees from One-Pass Block Drafters
CAST.summary: CAST packs the candidates a block drafter has already scored into a tree, verifies it in a single target pass, and sets the tree width from a latency measurement.

directional-verification.title: Distilling Directional Verification
directional-verification.summary: A teacher that cannot generate a reverse answer can still score candidates in the direction it knows, and the best-scoring candidate becomes the student's training target.

PRISM.title: Predicting and Repairing Merge Collapse in Large Language Models
PRISM.summary: A pre-merge score built on the variance of task vectors across specialists exceeds its threshold only for destructive merges, and PRISM, which soft-thresholds the averaged task vector at that variance's scale, keeps those merges near the base without data or tuning.

CLO.title: Cross-Lingual Optimization for Language Transfer in Large Language Models
CLO.summary: CLO transfers an English-centric LLM to a target language while preserving its English capabilities, using publicly available English SFT data and a translation model.
